# WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner 5.0.4

The package description now matches the version it accompanies. The repository provides a browser-ready synthetic sample report and a reproducible sample PDF for inspecting the evidence format. This release also includes the dependency updates recorded in the changelog.

The release has six assets: the standalone runtime, wheel, normalized source distribution, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence.

Automated accessibility findings require manual review before making conformance claims. Keep private site and document content out of public reports.
